signedOutDescription: Save your progress and receive updates in your inbox. Already registered? Enter the same email to sign in on this device.
pendingDescription: We sent an email to {{email}}. Open the link in it, or enter the code here:
syncSynced: Your progress is saved in your account.
syncSyncing: Saving your progress in your account …
syncPending: Your progress will be saved in your account when you're online again.
deleteConfirm: Delete your account and everything stored in it? Your progress stays on this device.
confirmed: Your email address is confirmed – you're signed in.
signedOut: You're signed out. Your progress stays on this device.
deleted: Your account was deleted. Your progress stays on this device.
passwordDescription: Sign in with the password you set in your account.
passwordOff: Set a password to sign in without waiting for an email. The sign-in link keeps working.
passwordOn: You can sign in with your password or with a sign-in link.
removePasswordConfirm: Remove your password? You can still sign in with a link by email.
passwordRemoved: Your password is removed. Sign in with a link by email.

errors.invalid-email: This email address doesn't look right.
errors.invalid-code: This code isn't right. Check the email and try again.
errors.invalid-link: This link isn't valid. Request a new email.
errors.expired: This link or code has expired. Request a new email.
errors.already-used: This link or code was used already. Request a new email to sign in on this device.
errors.too-many-attempts: Too many wrong codes. Request a new email.
errors.too-many-requests: Too many emails in a short time. Try again in an hour.
errors.mail-failed: The email could not be sent. Try again later.
errors.offline: No connection to the server. Check your internet connection.
errors.unauthorized: You're signed out. Sign in again.
errors.server-error: Something went wrong. Try again later.
errors.invalid-credentials: Email or password isn't right. No password yet? Send a sign-in link.
errors.too-many-password-attempts: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in an hour, or send a sign-in link.
errors.password-too-short: The password needs at least 8 characters.
errors.password-too-long: This password is too long. Use a shorter one.
